notes: §1985:VI.5.15.2 prints two formats: Format 1, VALUE IS literal-1 (IS not underlined), and Format 2, the choice of VALUE IS or VALUES ARE followed by one or more literal-2, each with an optional THROUGH or THRU literal-3; §1985:VI.5.15.5 rule 2: "Format 2 can be used only in connection with condition-names". The grammar rule valueClause parses one superset of both and of the later editions' formats, and the binder narrows it by level: on a data item DataBinder.BindEntry refuses a second literal (COBOL1585) and a THROUGH range (COBOL2167) and CheckValueConnective refuses VALUES and ARE (COBOL2177); on a level-88 entry BindCondition takes the list and the ranges and CheckValueConnective holds VALUE to IS and VALUES to ARE, the two options the brace prints; RawValueOperandText refuses an operand that is not a literal (COBOL1639). The 1985 edition reaches these with no arm of its own; what 1985 lacks is refused by gates: VersionConformancePass.VisitValueClause the table format with FROM (COBOL0900), VisitValueClauseFalsePhrase WHEN SET TO FALSE, VisitValidateValidPhrase the validation tail, and the range's IN alphabet-name, the concatenation operator and the hexadecimal literal by their own 2002 gates. The witness declares VALUE 5 and VALUES ARE 3 THRU 6 9 and tests the condition-name. Probed further at --std 85 (32 entries): VALUE with and without IS, signed, ALL literal and figurative operands, a group VALUE, and level-88 lists with VALUE IS, VALUES ARE, commas, THRU and THROUGH are accepted; on a data item VALUES, VALUE ARE, two literals, a range, no literal, a data-name, 1 + 2, LENGTH OF and a second VALUE clause are refused; on a level 88, VALUES IS, VALUE ARE, a missing VALUE clause, THRU with no literal-3, a doubled THRU, a PICTURE clause, a data-name operand, FALSE, IN and INVALID are refused; VALUE on a level 66 is refused.

next.reason: 1985: "VALUE IS / VALUES ARE { literal-2 [ THROUGH/THRU literal-3 ] } …"; 2023: "literal-2 [THROUGH literal-3] … [ IN alphabet-name-1 ] [ WHEN SET TO FALSE IS literal-4 ]". Format 1 is unchanged. The condition-name format (2023 Format 3) adds the optional IN alphabet-name-1 and WHEN SET TO FALSE phrases, and 2023 adds table, report and validation formats.
